```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))

ga <- resolve_ga(params$ga)
```

```{r}
# Read committee data from people JSON
committee_data <- read_json(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$people_json, paste0(params$people_id, ".json"))) |>
  pluck("person")

# Read related data
bills <- read_csv(ga_csv("bills", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
sponsors <- read_csv(ga_csv("sponsors", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
rollcalls <- read_csv(ga_csv("rollcalls", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Determine chamber
chamber_name <- if (committee_data$role == "Sen") "Senate" else "House"
committee_name <- committee_data$name
committee_id <- committee_data$committee_id
```

# `r chamber_name` `r committee_name`

**Chamber:** `r chamber_name`
**Committee ID:** `r committee_id`

---

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Bills Referred

```{r}
referred_bills <- bills |>
  filter(committee_id == !!committee_id) |>
  mutate(bill_link = format_bill_link(bill_number, bill_dir_href(ga, up = 2))) |>
  select(bill_link, title, status_desc, status_date, last_action_date, last_action) |>
  arrange(desc(last_action_date))

if (nrow(referred_bills) > 0) {
  gt(referred_bills) |>
    cols_label(
      bill_link = "Bill",
      title = "Title",
      status_desc = "Status",
      status_date = "Status Date",
      last_action_date = "Last Action Date",
      last_action = "Last Action"
    ) |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = bill_link) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = bill_link)
    ) |>
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(12),
      data_row.padding = px(4)
    ) |>
    opt_interactive(
      use_search = TRUE,
      use_filters = TRUE,
      use_page_size_select = TRUE,
      page_size_default = 25
    )
} else {
  cat("No bills referred to this committee.\n")
}
```

## Bills Sponsored

```{r}
sponsored_bills <- sponsors |>
  filter(people_id == params$people_id) |>
  left_join(bills, by = "bill_id") |>
  mutate(bill_link = format_bill_link(bill_number, bill_dir_href(ga, up = 2))) |>
```

## Committee Votes

```{r}
# Match rollcalls where the description contains the committee name
# Pattern: "{Chamber}.*{Committee Name}.*Report"
vote_pattern <- str_glue("{chamber_name}.*{committee_name}.*Report")

committee_votes <- rollcalls |>
  filter(str_detect(description, regex(vote_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  left_join(bills |> select(bill_id, bill_number, title), by = "bill_id") |>
  mutate(bill_link = format_bill_link(bill_number, bill_dir_href(ga, up = 2))) |>
  select(bill_link, title, date, description, yea, nay, nv, absent, total) |>
  arrange(desc(date))

if (nrow(committee_votes) > 0) {
  gt(committee_votes) |>
    cols_label(
      bill_link = "Bill",
      title = "Title",
      date = "Date",
      description = "Description",
      yea = "Yea",
      nay = "Nay",
      nv = "NV",
      absent = "Absent",
      total = "Total"
    ) |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = bill_link) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = bill_link)
    ) |>
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(12),
      data_row.padding = px(4)
    ) |>
    opt_interactive(
      use_search = TRUE,
      use_filters = TRUE,
      use_page_size_select = TRUE,
      page_size_default = 25
    )
} else {
  cat("No committee votes found.\n")
}
```
